text: You want to know how much balance does your gift card have. Also, for your recent order, whether you used your visa, mastercard, or amex credit card. You also wonder if you can apply the gift card balance to the order. If not, you want to change your payment method to visa, because the other two cards have a lot of balance.
zh: 您想知道您的礼品卡有多少余额。另外，关于您最近的订单，您是否使用了Visa、Mastercard或Amex信用卡。您还想知道是否可以将礼品卡余额用于该订单。如果不行，您想将支付方式更改为Visa，因为另外两张卡有很多余额 (#W1234567, 商品id, 产品名称)。
